profile_text.body:
Fathom is a San Francisco-based company, founded in 2020, that offers an AI-powered meeting notetaker for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls. The company describes itself as a tool that captures, transcribes, and summarizes calls automatically, and offers a free tier for individual users alongside team-oriented plans that include AI-powered CRM updates, smart action items, and call insights. A feature called "Ask Fathom" allows users to search across their meeting history and generate customizable AI summaries tailored to a team's workflow.

The product also includes AI Scorecards, which the company describes as providing real-time coaching moments, follow-up metrics, and performance tracking to help managers coach their teams. Fathom is categorized in the notes, knowledge, and meetings space, with an emphasis on consent and privacy alongside its core transcription and CRM sync capabilities.

The held facts show Fathom is a public company trading under the ticker FTHM, with a CIK of 0001753162 on file, and is registered in California with 161 associated law exposure entries in that state. The company also maintains a Model Context Protocol server under the name ai.fathom.api/mcp, described as giving AI assistants real meeting context so that outputs are grounded in a user's actual work.
